name: Go vertical scrolling shooter with Ebiten

mentions.name: Go vertical scrolling shooter with Ebiten
mentions.description: A vertical scrolling shooter game written in Go using the Ebiten library, built as a hands-on way to learn the language. It is kept private and will probably never be released. Current work involves studying how to implement a memory pool for actors, since garbage collection and hundreds of short-lived bullet objects mix poorly.
mentions.problem: Garbage collection doesn't mix well with hundreds of short-lived bullet objects, motivating study of memory pools for actors.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've started to learn Go. By doing a vertical scrolling shooter with embiten. Kinda like fitting a square peg into a round hole. No, it's not public and will probably never be.
